_comment: Scheduled nonstop routes at CNX and CEI. Route list + per_month (arrivals a month) from FlightConnections flights-to pages (2 Aug 2026) cross-checked with Wikipedia; refreshed 3 Oct 2026 for the northern winter 2026/27 season (25 Oct 2026 - 27 Mar 2027) from AeroRoutes, airline schedule pages (Nok Air, Lao Airlines, Spring Airlines), Korea Airportal, airline press releases and Thai/Korean/Chinese news. Every value names its source: route['src'] maps a field to a source id; each timetable row in out/in carries its own src. out = departures from our airport, in = arrivals into it; times local; days 1=Mon..7=Sun; valid = 'from/to'. Rows without days are printed on the route card but kept off the day board. 'seen' = times seen on a booking or current-schedule page on given dates, not a timetable. per_month: src.per_month says which month and how. block_min = median gate-to-gate minutes of the out rows (UTC offsets applied). FlightConnections and flightsfrom.com now sit behind bot challenges and were not used for this refresh. Research cache: cache/flights-research/. Layer: flights_layer.py (python3 flights_layer.py regenerates the page).
